item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
There is nothing more laborious then reading a setting in layman's terms, unless it's intriguingly put into layman's terms.

I'm confused what you mean by this. Are you saying it is boring to read a direct description of a setting? I don't really know how I could've spiced it up without being circuitous, and its only 4 sentences, so its not like that paragraph is very long. Sure, it's not poetry, but I don't understand what makes the opening so boring for you.

Come one, you can come up with better descriptive text then: "The heartbeat monitor".

While I generally appreciate critique, I do not appreciate when the critique becomes "you're better than this". Mostly because it implies that you don't think I tried in the first place. In this particular circumstance, I'm curious what you think would have been better than "The heartbeat monitor", especially given that is the correct term for what I'm describing.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I'm onboard with Seagull here, i found the article choppy to say the least. I wasn't particularly intrigued by the dialog either. The Scenario that the article starts out with is killer in concept, but sadly, very very poorly preformed. Normally i'd be moved by such an introduction, but i just wasn't and therefor didn't have it in me to hold the remainder of the article to a impartial regard. Some specifics of why i disliked it.

  • There is nothing more laborious then reading a setting in layman's terms, unless it's intriguingly put into layman's terms. I'm bored to death by reading though the first paragraph of this because i can't visualize any of it. Perhaps if this article started with "I'm your daughter" "Wha-, I have no daughter! I have sons! Two sons!" you could have gotten me interested. But it doesn't it starts with witty or interesting dialogue, it starts with a setting thats boring to read.
  • On the subject of the dialogue itself, it seems to be drawn-out and simplified. While that would be fine if it where, say, a dialogue that established characters thought as feelings, its not that, it is a continues dialogue without any kind of hook.
  • Come one, you can come up with better descriptive text then: "The heartbeat monitor".
